title: 1949 green fireball meeting at Los Alamos

tellings.quote: his name is actually on a document from 1949 and it's this green fireball problem and it's him and Lincoln Leaz

plain: In 1949, at the Los Alamos weapons laboratory in New Mexico, the physicist Edward Teller and the meteor expert Lincoln LaPaz both took part in a meeting about the "green fireball problem", bright green lights seen in the skies over New Mexico at the time. Michels tells this himself, pointing to a 1949 document from the meeting that has both men's names on it. He raises it because it shows a top weapons scientist was involved in studying the lights.
